cites.quote: the day schedule for booked, empty and cancelled dates stays pinned by the existing APT-10 and APT-6 tests (C9)
Given a doctor and date with only a Cancelled appointment, when staff read that day schedule before and after the change, then both responses are the same.

findings.text: C9 says APT-10 and APT-6 pin the day schedule for booked, empty and Cancelled dates. APT-6 never reads /slots: it cancels and then books 11:00. No test reads the day schedule for a Cancelled-only date or a date with no appointment (S-6 AC3, AC2), yet doctorService.ts changed.
